actions.title: Create Payment
actions.description: Creates a new payment.

inputSchema.description: Body parameters to create a payment.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, USD.

value.description: Decimal amount as a string with 2 decimals, e.g. "10.00"

description.description: Payment description, will be shown to the customer.

redirectUrl.description: URL the customer is redirected to after payment (required for most hosted checkout flows).

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL Mollie calls for status updates.

method.description: Force a payment method (e.g., ideal, creditcard, paypal).

locale.description: Locale for the hosted payment pages, e.g. nl_NL, en_US.

sequenceType.description: One-off or recurring indicator: oneoff, first, recurring.

customerId.description: Customer ID if creating a payment for a customer.

mandateId.description: Mandate ID when charging a customer with a mandate.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON you can store with the payment.

testmode.description: Set true to force testmode when using a live OAuth token (for development only).

serviceJson.name: appmixer.mollie
serviceJson.label: Mollie
serviceJson.description: Mollie Payments API (v2). Base URL: https://api.mollie.com. Supports core operations: payments, refunds, payment links, customers, mandates, subscriptions, orders, shipments, balances, settlements, invoices, and chargebacks. Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (recommended for marketplace apps) via https://www.mollie.com/oauth2/authorize and https://api.mollie.com/oauth2/tokens. API keys are also supported for first-party integrations (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>). Common headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/hal+json, optional Idempotency-Key for safely retryable POST requests. Common query params: from, limit (max 250), testmode (OAuth to access test data), profileId (OAuth context). Rate limiting: Mollie throttles requests and returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; implement exponential backoff and honor Retry-After. Version: v2 endpoints under /v2.
